## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build` — tooling, configuration or dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (e.g. `feat(timeline): add zoom presets`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `develop` and targets the correct base branch
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for new logic (especially `features/*/lib`)
- [ ] Documentation was updated (README, CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`, ADRs) when relevant
- [ ] UI changes were checked in dark and light themes and with keyboard navigation
